name: Uchinoura Space Center
best_known_for: Japan's first satellite Ohsumi (1970), the M-V rockets, Hayabusa and Epsilon
credit: Launch site of Japan's scientific satellites, on the Pacific coast of Kagoshima Prefecture; it was the Kagoshima Space Center until JAXA formed in 2003. The first orbital attempt, a Lambda 4S on 26 September 1966, failed; Ohsumi reached orbit on 11 February 1970. Facts from Wikipedia (Uchinoura Space Center, Lambda, Ohsumi, M-V, Epsilon), the ISAS Ohsumi page and the JAXA site page; coordinates are the Lambda pad on Wikipedia.
